subject: houndeye
leg: control: Valve's own against the brief
label: houndeye, in the place of the game's models/houndeye.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/gman.mdl, models/scientist.mdl, models/hassassin.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked A, B, C, C where the asset was C, A, B, B: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Side and angle views (LEFT, RIGHT, FRONT-LEFT, BACK-RIGHT) show the brief's outline: a squat, low body on three thin legs with a rounded front. Nothing sticks out or is missing in any view. The dorsal plates on the back are part of the hide, not extra outline.

M2.reason: Measured size 49.3 long and 44.7 high against the brief's 49 and 45, both within 15%. Width 33.5 is not asked for by the brief.

M3.reason: Brief parts checked down to the small ones: one large eye on the front (FRONT view: a big dark pitted disc with a rim, about 60% of body width), three legs (FRONT view: two outer legs and one centre leg), splayed foot pads visible at the leg ends in LEFT and RIGHT, and the striped back (teal, brown and yellow bands on TOP and BACK). All are there in the right places. The belly's red oval and the small block at the rear underside are not in the brief and do not count against it.

M4.reason: Body is yellow-olive as the brief says, with teal and brown stripes and a cream belly. The eye is dark and pitted, a suitable material for the eye. Nothing is in a colour the brief rules out.

M5.reason: The striped and dappled hide is there and in place across the back and flanks (LEFT, BACK, TOP). Sharpness is adequate at the picture scale. Some streaking on the underside (BELOW) is softer than the back, but it is not a fault against the brief.

M6.reason: Measured by the line-up test: the asset was never picked as the one not made by Valve (picks were A, B, C, C; the asset sat at C, A, B, B in those readings). Capped at 2 as the rubric directs.

M7.reason: The eye-bearing side is the front (FRONT view), the body stands upright, and the three feet sit on one floor line in the LEFT and FRONT views.

M8.reason: SMAK checkErrors is empty. Triangle count 308 is under the Half-Life median of its kind (576) and under the three-quarters mark (740). The eye disc reads as a closed textured pit in FRONT and FRONT-LEFT, with no open or floating part visible. The underside is not a player-visible fault.

C1.reason: In motion.png (run frames 0/18 to 18/18) and attack.png (frames 0/59 to 59/59) the legs, body, plates and eye stay joined through the cycle. The legs reach the floor line at contact and nothing sinks, floats or detaches. The original's motion is not in the pictures, so this is judged for coherence against the brief.
